intake_procedure.title: INTAKE PROCEDURE (REV. 9)
intake_procedure.text:
Occupants are woken one at a time.

Do not tell an occupant their number. Do not tell an occupant how many numbers came before theirs.

If an occupant asks about the pods in Storage, the answer is: maintenance.

If an occupant asks who wrote this procedure, the answer is: you did.

- Facility administration

pod_note.title: NOTE, TAPED INSIDE A LOCKER
pod_note.text:
The occupant in pod 4 is not what the intake sheet says it is.

It eats when it is watched. It does not eat when it is not.

If it ever reads this, it will not be able to. They made sure of that.

service_log.title: SERVICE LOG, UNIT 7
service_log.subject:
Unit 7 recalibrated. Unit 7 recalibrated. Unit 7 recalibrated.

The same entry fills every page, in the same hand, at the same minute. The last page is stamped with your occupant number: {iteration}.
service_log.visitor:
Unit 7 keeps walking the east corridor after shutdown. We stopped logging it.

Whoever reads this: it is not looking for a way out. It is looking for a way in.

The handwriting changes halfway down the page, and keeps going after the last line, off the edge of the paper.
